name: Green Teen Alliance
what_you_do: Join a group led by paid C3 interns. It works with high school green clubs and plans climate action in schools and the community.
who_can_apply: High school students in the Charlottesville area. Grade levels are not stated.
pay_detail: Not stated. The page says paid interns lead the group but does not say if teen members are paid.
how_to_apply: Use the sign-up form on the C3 youth page.
notes: The same page says C3 takes high school and college interns each term. Work includes grants, policy, marketing and energy checks. Pay and ages are not stated. See the careers page of C3.
